_doc: tools/assets/rock_palettes.py — the default rock palettes (textures/rocks/palettes.json), one per rock_rules formation. Built by tools/assets/rock_palettes.py; edit palettes in the editor, not here.
amount_doc: amount: 0 = the scans as photographed, 1 = the scans' pattern in the palette's colours.

bar_harbor_formation.name: Bar Harbor Formation (siltstone, sandstone)
bar_harbor_formation.source: mean colour of luminance bands p5-25 / p40-60 / p75-95 of the scans (top: Matt's 3 Nov photo docs/look/matt_3nov_coa_rock_joints_flat.jpg, whole frame at 512 px, detail pixels (textures/rocks/ref/coa_bar_harbor_fm_top.jpg); face: Matt's 3 Nov photo docs/look/matt_3nov_coa_shore_ledges_autumn.jpg, (340,700)-(2500,940), the ledges above the water, detail pixels (textures/rocks/ref/coa_bar_harbor_fm_face.jpg); lichen: mossy_rock 0.5)

granites.name: Granite
granites.source: mean colour of luminance bands p5-25 / p40-60 / p75-95 of the scans (top: Matt's reference for Cadillac granite: Poly Haven namaqualand_stones_01 diffuse (CC0), detail pixels only (textures/rocks/ref/namaqualand_stones_01.jpg); face: Matt's reference for Cadillac granite: Poly Haven namaqualand_stones_01 diffuse (CC0), detail pixels only (textures/rocks/ref/namaqualand_stones_01.jpg); lichen: lichen_rock 0.6)

gabbro_diorite.name: Gabbro and diorite
gabbro_diorite.source: mean colour of luminance bands p5-25 / p40-60 / p75-95 of the scans (top: Matt's reference for gabbro-diorite: Poly Haven coastal_cliff_04 diffuse (CC0), detail pixels, moss left out (textures/rocks/ref/coastal_cliff_04.jpg); face: Nubble Lighthouse scan (Cape Neddick, Matt's upload nubble_lighthouse__cape_neddick_maine.glb): ortho of the scan, pixels on 25-70 deg slopes, not green, median of 612k px. Cape Neddick gabbro-diorite: right rock type, 100 km from MDI.; lichen: lichen_rock 0.4)

schist.name: Schist and gneiss
schist.source: mean colour of luminance bands p5-25 / p40-60 / p75-95 of the scans (top: seaside_rock 1; face: dark_rock 1; lichen: mossy_rock 0.5)

volcanics.name: Volcanics
volcanics.source: mean colour of luminance bands p5-25 / p40-60 / p75-95 of the scans (top: rock_face_04 1; face: marble_cliff_06 1; lichen: mossy_rock 0.5)

dikes.name: Dikes (basalt, diabase, aplite)
dikes.source: mean colour of luminance bands p5-25 / p40-60 / p75-95 of the scans (top: dark_rock 1; face: dark_rock 1; lichen: mossy_rock 0.3)
